title: Agentic AI: User Empowerment or Foreclosure?
abstract: arXiv:2608.06510v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agentic AI promises systems that can act on users' behalf, from filtering content to negotiating prices to selecting services. Whether it will empower users is an open question, and one that depends on more than the technology. We conduct a comparative case analysis of four earlier, more mature domains in which similar forms of agency emerged: browser-based ad blockers, platform recommender systems, financial robo-advisors, and email spam filtering. Across the cases, questions about whose interests agents would serve were resolved through technical arrangements: API choices, protocol governance, industry standards, and default configurations. Beyond their technical form, these were political decisions. We identify this settling of contestable questions in a technical form as depoliticization, a concept from political theory, here at work in technological systems. translated_title: 代理型人工智能：用户赋权还是剥夺？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.06510v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：代理型人工智能承诺提供能够代表用户行动的系统，从内容过滤到价格谈判再到服务选择。它是否会赋予用户权力是一个开放性问题，且这一问题不仅仅取决于技术。我们对四个较早且更成熟的领域进行了比较案例研究，在这些领域中出现了类似形式的代理：基于浏览器的广告拦截器、平台推荐系统、金融机器人顾问和电子邮件垃圾邮件过滤。在这些案例中，关于代理将服务于谁的利益的问题通过技术安排得以解决：API选择、协议治理、行业标准和默认配置。除了其技术形式外，这些还是政治决策。我们将这种在技术形式中解决争议性问题的方式识别为去政治化，这一概念来自政治理论，在此应用于技术系统。其最深远的影响是，个体结果和集体结果……
tldr: 本文通过比较四个成熟领域的案例，揭示了代理型AI中关键利益问题如何通过技术安排被“去政治化”解决，从而影响用户赋权，而非单纯依赖技术本身。
en_tdlr: This paper compares four mature domains to reveal how key interest questions in agentic AI are resolved through technical arrangements as "depoliticization," shaping user empowerment beyond mere technology.
